lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiCuPbO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with a unit cell containing 28 atoms—Li₄Cu₄Pb₄O₁₆—and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for both Cu and Li centers, each surrounded by four O neighbors, while Pb adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Cu tetrahedra, between Cu tetrahedra and Pb octahedra, and between Li tetrahedra and Pb octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
